title: Friction and Viscosity
coreMove: Separate useful resistance from avoidable drag, then remove the drag before blaming the goal.
sourcePressure: Friction and viscosity explain how the surrounding medium slows movement and makes progress heavier than the objective itself.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: calling every obstacle bad or treating speed as the only value

hook: opening with a definition of Friction and Viscosity
counterintuition: calling every obstacle bad or treating speed as the only value
tryThisNow: set a timer and think about it
audit your life with no chapter-specific object
examples: same dashboard meeting with swapped names
kitchen-table family argument unless the domain requires it
teacher and student scene used as default proof

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

tryThisNowSpec: In the next decision involving friction, write one sentence naming the concrete force, constraint, or condition from this model, then change one visible action before the moment passes. Keep it under 90 seconds.
